title: Run fresh evidence exchange and the real-Git exchange and retained-construction suites on macOS and Linux
outcome: Run fresh evidence exchange and the real-Git exchange and retained-construction suites on macOS and Linux
acceptance: Fresh task-sync evidence exchange runs on macOS and Linux through the same confined runner and policy checks as Windows; the cfg!(windows) refusal in src/task_sync/exchange/evidence.rs is gone and fresh and replayed requests take the same guard path

The real-Git data-branch exchange tests (HTTPS fetch, non-force push, tip observation; today src/task_sync/exchange/tests.rs `mod windows`) and the retained-construction, audit_deadlines, data_bootstrap, orphan and writer_probe suites (src/storage/work/task_sync/ledger/operations/checkpoint_tests.rs) compile and pass on macOS and Linux as well as Windows; any case kept Windows-only carries a cfg gate with a named reason
When the cleanup thread cannot be created, the controller publishes its NotLaunched outcome before it leaves the pending registry, so a concurrent drain never reports a spurious cleanup failure
